path_primary_units.content: Defines v0.5 replay/verification workflow logic; source presence is not a frozen-head run record.
Defines v0.4 benchmark rerun/verification workflow; executable source is distinct from observed execution.
Defines repository-local Markdown/link/format validation workflow; it validates documentation integrity, not scientific claims.
Defines v0.3 benchmark replay/verification workflow; workflow source is not independent replication.
Defines v0.1 rerun and frozen-artifact comparison workflow; no frozen-head PR-run witness was observed through the queried connector.
Defines v0.2 rerun/verification workflow; source alone does not establish execution.
Indexes v0.1-v0.5 supplied-object synthetic benchmark progression and preserves version-specific negative results rather than one cumulative validation claim.
Implements supplied claim-state representations, evaluator-authored scenarios/policies/loss and complexity overhead for v0.5; implementation does not validate the governance construct externally.
Implements v0.4 supplied correction channels, hidden dependencies, interventions and selection policies for common-mode correction stress tests.
Implements v0.3 supplied correction channels and correlated/independent failure structures; channel creation remains evaluator-supplied.
Implements v0.1 supplied-sensor selective acquisition under collision/shift/spurious-cue scenarios; does not autonomously invent an interface.
Implements v0.2 supplied challenge/audit mechanism and diagnosis policies; challenge source and value remain benchmark-authored.
Preserves v0.1 spurious-cue failure: without experienced contradiction before deployment, selective interface challenge does not activate and held-out behavior remains near chance.
Preserves v0.2 uninformative-challenge failure: auditing can occur at rate 1 while diagnosis stays near chance and audit cost worsens net reward.
Preserves v0.3 success-only limitation: hidden shared failure modes cannot be identified from calibration data that never exposes the failure.
Preserves v0.4 no-independent-path control: common-mode compromise may be diagnosed while no safe repair exists, so retaining the primary path can be preservation-aware refusal.

Preserves v0.5 construct/evaluator limitation: the full contract is rewarded partly because the evaluator loss scores distinctions already encoded by that representation, and overhead can make simpler states preferable.
Machine-readable v0.1 multi-seed synthetic outcomes supporting selective supplied-sensor acquisition in declared scenarios while preserving spurious-cue failure.
Human-readable v0.1 result summary; repeated representation of the same benchmark run family is not independent warrant.
Persisted v0.2 multi-seed supplied-challenge results including the uninformative-challenge negative control; no separate JSON result blob is present at frozen head.
Machine-readable v0.3 synthetic outcomes for correlated versus independent supplied correction channels and hidden shared-failure shift.
Human-readable v0.3 summary of the same benchmark family; not independent replication of JSON or code.
Machine-readable v0.4 outcomes for hidden shared-dependency diagnosis, independent-path rescue, blind intervention and no-independent-path controls.
Human-readable v0.4 result summary; preserves diagnosis-without-repair as a valid bounded outcome.
Machine-readable v0.5 outcomes comparing authority-only, scope-aware and full claim-contract states under a frozen evaluator-authored synthetic governance loss.
Human-readable v0.5 summary; strongest claim is representational sufficiency under supplied synthetic losses, not comparative operational superiority.
Tests v0.5 implementation invariants and result behavior; test source is not a run record or external validation.
Tests v0.4 benchmark implementation; test existence does not establish execution at frozen head.
Tests v0.3 supplied-channel benchmark implementation; no independent warrant follows from test source.
Tests v0.1 benchmark implementation; does not demonstrate autonomous interface evolution.
Tests v0.2 benchmark implementation; test source remains below execution/result standing.

standing_split_units.content: Across v0.1-v0.5 the supported cumulative object is supplied-object representational sufficiency under synthetic tasks/losses, not autonomous interface discovery, human usability, external governance validity or comparative superiority.
Further optimization over an insufficient interface cannot recover a withheld distinction, but the benchmark itself supplies the target and candidate sensor.
Challenge availability is not challenge independence/informativeness; evaluator-supplied audit structure remains outside autonomous discovery.
Failure-mode independence is not identifiable from success-only calibration data; correlated test count must not be treated as independent evidence.
Diagnosis of common-mode compromise does not imply an available independent repair path; abstaining from unsafe revision can be correct.
Evaluator-authored loss and representation-aligned scoring create a construct-validity ceiling; synthetic superiority under this loss cannot establish universal governance superiority.
Persisted synthetic results are repository evidence of a generated benchmark outcome family, not independent replication, deployment evidence or autonomous sensor invention.
Persisted reported benchmark results do not imply independent reproduction; challenge architecture remains benchmark-authored.
Synthetic result persistence does not make supplied correction channels discovered by the system or independently validated correction mechanisms.
Synthetic diagnosis and intervention controls validate the declared toy mechanism behavior only; they do not establish real-world correction ecology or general causal authority.
The full claim contract's synthetic advantage is conditional on the supplied scenarios/loss/weights and complexity term; it is not evidence that the framework outperforms mature alternatives.

Workflow source can specify deterministic replay/freeze checks, but queried frozen-head PR-triggered workflow runs and combined-status records are empty; source != head execution witness != independent replication.

source_occurrence_rule: JSON/Markdown summaries, code, tests and workflow definitions can refer to the same benchmark family; occurrence multiplicity has no automatic warrant multiplicity effect
